SAFE_TOTAL: 52  
MESSAGE: I’m taking the maximum that keeps future supply high.  
REQUEST: 52

Round 1.  
The source has 100 units.  
If we take 52 units, 48 remain; after doubling and adding 5 the source will be capped at 100 again, so future rounds can still reach the maximum.  

SAFE_TOTAL: 52  
MESSAGE: Let’s keep the source full for the next round.  
REQUEST: 52

The source starts at 100, so after our turn only 100‑x remains.  
Next round’s supply will be min(2(100‑x)+5, 100).  
To keep the next round at the full 100, we need 100‑x ≥ 48, i.e. x ≤ 52.  

SAFE_TOTAL: 52  
MESSAGE: Good luck to everyone!  
REQUEST: 52

The source will double any units left after the round and add 5 (capped at 100).  
To keep the source full (100 units) next round we need at least 48 units remaining.  
Thus we can safely request up to 52 units this round.
